description: This file defines the code-behind for the EditMCQ page in an online examination system. It manages user interactions such as navigation between pages, selecting courses based on semester/year, and storing selected course information in session variables.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Partial class associated with the EditMCQ.aspx WebForm page. Handles page load events, button clicks for navigation, and dropdown selection changes to populate courses based on the selected semester.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load of the page; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester, with predefined course codes.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores the selected course in session state.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Replicates the logic in selectB_Click to update course options based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Empty handler for course dropdown change event.
